name: plstudio-brand
description: Brand tokens for plstudio. Source of truth for marketing and, later, the UI theme.

night.usage: Sole dark surface for app icon, favicon and mark backgrounds; primary UI background.

sand.usage: Fennec body and ears; primary brand accent on dark surfaces.

copper.usage: Code brackets in the mark, inner ears, wordmark 'pl'. Secondary accent.

cream.usage: Muzzle, belly and tail tip of the mascot, wordmark 'studio', primary text on dark surfaces.

focus.usage: UI-only success and focus states. Never used in logos.
